hero.headline: Know your caffeine. Own your <1>sleep</1>.
hero.subtitle: A caffeine tracker that actually learns your metabolism and sleep patterns. Not some generic chart. Yours.

features.heading: What's actually going on with your <1>caffeine</1>

metabolism.label: Scientific
metabolism.title: Personalized Metabolism
metabolism.description: Your caffeine half-life isn't average. Tazza factors in pregnancy, birth control, smoking, medications, and sensitivity to build your actual decay curve.

sleepCountdown.label: Intelligent
sleepCountdown.title: Sleep-Safe Countdown
sleepCountdown.description: A real-time countdown to when your caffeine drops below the sleep-safe threshold. No more wondering if that afternoon coffee will keep you up.

quickLog.label: Effortless
quickLog.title: 2-Tap Logging
quickLog.description: Log any drink in two taps. Smart predictions learn your habits and surface your usual order at the right time.

watch.label: On Your Wrist
watch.title: Apple Watch
watch.description: Complications on your watch face. Quick-log from your wrist. Caffeine status at a glance.

widgets.label: Always Visible
widgets.title: Widgets & Live Activities
widgets.description: Lock screen, home screen, and Dynamic Island. Your caffeine level without unlocking your phone.

step1.title: Log your drink
step1.description: Two taps. That's it. Pick from 100+ pre-loaded drinks or add your own.

step2.title: See your curve
step2.description: Watch your personalized caffeine decay curve in real time, color-coded by zone.

step3.title: Know when you're sleep-ready
step3.description: A clear countdown tells you when caffeine drops below your sleep threshold.

drinkLibrary.heading: 100+ drinks, <1>USDA-accurate</1> data
drinkLibrary.description: Espresso, matcha, energy drinks, and more. Every caffeine value comes from USDA data. You can add your own drinks too.

testimonial.quote: I had no idea my afternoon cold brew was why I couldn't fall asleep. Tazza showed me exactly when to stop, and now I sleep like I used to.
testimonial.author: Early beta tester

finalCta.heading: Stop guessing about your <1>caffeine</1>
finalCta.benefit3: Your data stays on your device
